summary: Disaggregated scale-out block and file storage. Effective-capacity figures use HPE's stated 4:1 compaction assumption.

value: Data Services Cloud Console on HPE GreenLake

value.upgradeGranularity: Drives in 2-drive increments, from 8 to 24 SSDs per enclosure
value.effectiveAssumption: 4:1 compaction in RAID 6 (10+2), including thin provisioning, deduplication, compression, and copy technologies, plus 9% free-space headroom. Actual ratios vary by workload.
value.switchedScale: Up to 16 JBOF expansion shelves. Footnote 3 describes 16 JBOFs totalling 384 x 15.36 TB SSDs. Marketing text says from 15.36 TB to around 5.8 PB, and also up to 5.9 PB raw in a single system with 2 to 6 controller nodes.
value.switchless: 2U chassis can host two controller nodes and up to 24 SFF NVMe drives

storage.note: The 5.8 PB and 5.9 PB sentences both appear in the QuickSpecs and are both retained. They are not reconciled here.

value.hostPortsPerNode: 0-12 ports of 32/64 Gb FC or NVMe/FC on several models; 0-2 or 0-10 ports of 10/25 GbE and 0-2 ports of 100 GbE depending on the configuration table

value.count: Two power supplies required per chassis. The chassis does not include power supplies.
value.note: PSU ratings are not a system planning wattage.

processors.note: Controller CPU details were not extracted.

support.note: The QuickSpecs states a 100% data availability guarantee as a product claim. End-of-support dates were not retrieved.

firmwareBaseline.reason: No array software version is included.

referenceConfigurations.title: Switchless 2U chassis with two controller nodes and up to 24 NVMe SSDs
